# pbs_verify_job (Resource)

Manages a Proxmox Backup Server verify job: on a schedule, it reads the backups of a datastore, or of a namespace in it, and checks every chunk against its checksum, so that a damaged backup is found before it is needed. A backup that fails is marked, and the next backup of the same guest uploads its chunks again instead of reusing the damaged ones.

Deleting a datastore without `keep_job_configs` deletes its verify jobs too; a `pbs_verify_job` then plans to create its job again. Managing verify jobs needs `Datastore.Verify` on the datastore, reading them `Datastore.Audit` or `Datastore.Verify`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A weekly verification of pbs_datastore.store1, of the pbs_datastore
# example, assumed in the same configuration. Every Saturday at 03:00 it
# reads the backups that were never verified, or last verified more than 30
# days ago, and checks each chunk: ignore_verified, true by default, skips
# the others.
resource "pbs_verify_job" "store1" {
  id             = "verify-store1"
  store          = pbs_datastore.store1.name
  schedule       = "sat 03:00"
  outdated_after = 30
  comment        = "Weekly verification of cluster1's backups"

  # From PBS 4.1, read_threads and verify_threads set how many threads read
  # and check chunks; with PBS 4.0, the plan fails when they are set.
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Job ID, 3 to 32 characters: letters, digits, `_`, `.` and `-`, not starting with `.` or `-`. Changing it replaces the job.
- `store` (String) Name of the datastore to verify, such as the `name` of a `pbs_datastore`.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Free-form comment, up to 128 characters on one line.
- `ignore_verified` (Boolean) Whether to skip backups that were verified before, unless that verification is older than `outdated_after`. Defaults to `true`; `false` verifies every backup on every run.
- `max_depth` (Number) How many levels of namespaces below `ns` to verify too, from `0`, `ns` alone, to `7`, the default: all of them. Namespaces nest at most 7 levels deep, and PBS goes no deeper than that below `ns`.
- `ns` (String) Namespace to verify, such as `dept1` or `dept1/hosts`; the datastore's root namespace when left out.
- `outdated_after` (Number) With `ignore_verified`, how many days after its last verification a backup is verified again; when left out, a verified backup is never verified again.
- `read_threads` (Number) How many threads read chunks, 1 to 32. When left out, the datastore's `tuning.default_verification_readers` applies, and 1 without it. Needs PBS 4.1 or newer.
- `schedule` (String) When the job runs, as a PBS calendar event such as `daily`, `sat 03:00` or `mon..fri 22:00`. PBS checks it. Without a schedule, the job runs only when started by hand.
- `verify_threads` (Number) How many threads verify chunks, 1 to 32. When left out, the datastore's `tuning.default_verification_workers` applies, and 4 without it. Needs PBS 4.1 or newer.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = pbs_verify_job.store1
  identity = {
    id = "verify-store1"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) Job ID, such as `verify-store1`.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = pbs_verify_job.store1
  id = "verify-store1"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Verify jobs are imported by job ID, as `proxmox-backup-manager verify-job
# list` shows it.
terraform import pbs_verify_job.store1 verify-store1
```
